All 28 errors cascade from one broken kernel signature. Lines 36–38 currently read:

```
    const T* __restrict__ X,

__global__ void __launch_bounds__(256, 4) conv2d_tiled_kernel(
```

The `template <typename T, int CO>` header and the start of the parameter list were lost in a bad edit, and the `T* __restrict__ Y` output parameter is missing entirely (the kernel body writes to `Y` via `mY`, and the host launch at line 247 passes three pointers with instantiation `conv2d_tiled_kernel<cute::bfloat16_t, 32>`). The parser sees stray declarations with an undefined `T`, then a malformed `__global__` function, causing every downstream error (`CO`, `Cin`, `Y`, `pad` undefined; `stride` resolving to the CuTE helper; kernel undefined at launch).

The single fix is to replace lines 36–38 with the correct template header and full parameter-list opening, in the order matching the host launch arguments `(x, w, y, N, Cin, H, Win, KH, KW, stride, padding, Hout, Wout)`. The remaining signature lines (39–42) and the entire kernel body stay untouched, preserving the intent: implicit-GEMM conv2d with bf16 WMMA, skewed shared-memory leading dimensions, K-chunking by 32, and the accumulator aliasing optimization.
